findings.motion: House third reading passage, RCS# 712 (71 yeas, 16 nays); Tedford listed among the yeas
findings.note: Bill on voter registration: requires cancelling the registration of a voter found not to be a citizen, lets the State Election Board compare the voter list with other entities, requires notice to the voter and proof of citizenship furnished to the county election board, and limits access to the voter list.

findings.motion: House third reading (RCS# 1580) and adoption (RCS# 1581) of SJR47, constitutional amendment requiring proof of identity for voting; Tedford listed as excused on both, so no vote recorded
findings.note: He was excused and did not vote on the joint resolution that puts a proof-of-identity-to-vote amendment before Oklahoma voters.
